title: Copper(II) and silver(I)-1,10-phenanthroline-5,6-dione complexes interact with double-stranded DNA: further evidence of their apparent multi-modal activity towards Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Galdino, Anna Clara Milesi; Viganor, Livia; Pereira, Matheus Mendonca; Devereux, Michael; McCann, Malachy; Branquinha, Marta Helena; Molphy, Zara; O'Carroll, Sinead; Bain, Conor; Menounou, Georgia; Kellett, Andrew; Dos Santos, Andre Luis Souza
journal: Journal of biological inorganic chemistry : JBIC : a publication of the Society of Biological Inorganic Chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜/银-菲咯啉二酮配合物与双链DNA的结合，采用分子对接和体外实验揭示小沟优先结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系但非TF-DNA，方法含对接但无AI或MD深度建模，可借鉴其金属配合物-DNA界面识别思路。
abstract: Tackling microbial resistance requires continuous efforts for the development of new molecules with novel mechanisms of action and potent antimicrobial activity. Our group has previously identified metal-based compounds, [Ag(1,10-phenanthroline-5,6-dione)(2)]ClO(4) (Ag-phendione) and [Cu(1,10-phenanthroline-5,6-dione)(3)](ClO(4))(2).4H(2)O (Cu-phendione), with efficient antimicrobial action against multidrug-resistant species. Herein, we investigated the ability of Ag-phendione and Cu-phendione to bind with double-stranded DNA using a combination of in silico and in vitro approaches. Molecular docking revealed that both phendione derivatives can interact with the DNA by hydrogen bonding, hydrophobic and electrostatic interactions. Cu-phendione exhibited the highest binding affinity to either major (- 7.9 kcal/mol) or minor (- 7.2 kcal/mol) DNA grooves. In vitro competitive quenching assays involving duplex DNA with Hoechst 33258 or ethidium bromide demonstrated that Ag-phendione and Cu-phendione preferentially bind DNA in the minor grooves. The competitive ethidium bromide displacement technique revealed Cu-phendione has a higher binding affinity to DNA (K(app) = 2.55 x 10(6) M(-1)) than Ag-phendione (K(app) = 2.79 x 10(5) M(-1)) and phendione (K(app) = 1.33 x 10(5) M(-1)). Cu-phendione induced topoisomerase I-mediated DNA relaxation of supercoiled plasmid DNA. Moreover, Cu-phendione was able to induce oxidative DNA injuries with the addition of free radical scavengers inhibiting DNA damage. Ag-phendione and Cu-phendione avidly displaced propidium iodide bound to DNA in permeabilized Pseudomonas aeruginosa cells in a dose-dependent manner as judged by flow cytometry. The treatment of P. aeruginosa with bactericidal concentrations of Cu-phendione (15 microM) induced DNA fragmentation as visualized by either agarose gel or TUNEL assays. Altogether, these results highlight a possible novel DNA-targeted mechanism by which phendione-containing complexes, in part, elicit toxicity toward the multidrug-resistant pathogen P. aeruginosa.
abstract_zh: 应对微生物耐药性需要持续努力开发具有新作用机制和强效抗菌活性的新分子。我们课题组此前已鉴定出金属基化合物[Ag(1,10-菲咯啉-5,6-二酮)(2)]ClO(4)（Ag-phendione）和[Cu(1,10-菲咯啉-5,6-二酮)(3)](ClO(4))(2).4H(2)O（Cu-phendione），它们对多重耐药菌种具有高效抗菌作用。在此，我们结合计算机模拟和体外实验方法，研究了Ag-phendione和Cu-phendione与双链DNA结合的能力。分子对接 (molecular docking) 显示，两种phendione衍生物均可通过氢键、疏水相互作用和静电相互作用与DNA结合。Cu-phendione对DNA大沟（-7.9 kcal/mol）和小沟（-7.2 kcal/mol）均表现出最高的结合亲和力。涉及双链DNA与Hoechst 33258或溴化乙锭的体外竞争性淬灭实验表明，Ag-phendione和Cu-phendione优先结合DNA的小沟。竞争性溴化乙锭置换技术显示，Cu-phendione对DNA的结合亲和力（K(app) = 2.55 x 10(6) M(-1)）高于Ag-phendione（K(app) = 2.79 x 10(5) M(-1)）和phendione（K(app) = 1.33 x 10(5) M(-1)）。Cu-phendione诱导拓扑异构酶I介导的超螺旋质粒DNA松弛。此外，Cu-phendione能够诱导氧化性DNA损伤，而添加自由基清除剂可抑制DNA损伤。流式细胞术 (flow cytometry) 分析显示，在透化的铜绿假单胞菌 (Pseudomonas aeruginosa) 细胞中，Ag-phendione和Cu-phendione以剂量依赖方式强烈置换与DNA结合的碘化丙啶。用杀菌浓度的Cu-phendione（15微M）处理铜绿假单胞菌，通过琼脂糖凝胶或TUNEL实验可观察到DNA片段化。综上，这些结果突显了含phendione复合物可能通过一种新的DNA靶向机制，部分地对多重耐药病原体铜绿假单胞菌产生毒性作用。
